about_short_description.short_description: Duplo is a SAAS company that offers business finances automation services.

product.name: Duplo Global Accounts
product.description: Multi-currency business accounts enabling local collection and holding of funds in 70+ currencies with real bank accounts, FX management, and fast withdrawals.

product.name: Duplo Global Payments
product.description: A platform to send payments to over 160 countries in 80+ currencies with real-time FX, local bank and wallet payouts, and compliance management.

product.name: Approval Workflows
product.description: A digital system to automate and manage payment approval processes with customizable policies, routing, and dual control for fraud protection.

product.name: Bulk Payments
product.description: A service to process up to 500 payments simultaneously, simplifying payroll, vendor, and supplier payments with scheduling and error reduction.

product.name: Reimbursements
product.description: A platform for employees to submit expense claims with receipt uploads, automated approvals, and direct bank reimbursements.

product.name: Vendor Portal
product.description: A centralized platform to manage supplier invoices, approvals, payments, and early payment financing with real-time tracking.
